restrictions: Messages are independent uniform 33-byte strings from two charged random words, with discarded bits charged.
One batch n=2^128, two explicitly cleared tables of b=2^128 entries; no restart.
First full-digest equality causes terminal checking; repeated input causes failure.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256, two prefix rounds, one root compression per 33-byte message, flags11 length33 counter0.
Distribution-free finite probability proof; analytical RAM bounds, no heuristic or full-scale execution.
Read-only zero message lanes initialized once; separate mutable compression schedule; 93 wrapper and eight insertion operations per sample.
